newsitem.title: USA: Westbridge Capital files for note offering.
newsitem.headline: Westbridge Capital files for note offering.

text.p: Westbridge Capital Corp. filed on Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of $65 million of subordinated notes due 2007 that may be converted by holders into shares of common stock.

The Fort Worth, Texas-based company said it would use about $25 million of the proceeds of the sale to add statutory capital and surplus to its insurance subsidiaries and to recapture a block of reinsured insurance policies. The rest will be used for general corporate purposes, it said.
Underwriter Forum Capital Markets L.P. has an over-allotment option to buy up to an additional $9.75 principal amount of the notes, the company said.
